verdict.rationale: Gazebo is software you install and run on your own machines. First-party docs cover binary installs (the gz-jetty metapackage, ROS-matched installs, source-based installs), a headless server-only package for CI, and running the simulation on remote servers you control. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: To install all of them, the metapackage `gz-jetty` can be installed.
For headless and CI environments where the GUI is not needed, the `gz-sim10-server` package provides a lightweight alternative.
TCP/IP Transport: Run simulation on remote servers and interface to Gazebo Sim through socket-based message passing using Gazebo Transport.
Gazebo Sim can also be run headless, i.e. without the GUI, by using the -s (server only) flag.
